# Analysis: template-recall RSA
setting up model function 
```{r}
detail_emo_neuref <- function(curROI, model.stats.wbrsa) {

  # subset data for this ROI
  roiData <- roi.rsa.data %>% filter(as.character(ROI) == curROI)
  
  # skip if there’s no data 
  if (nrow(roiData) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ROI: ", curROI, " (no data)")
    return(model.stats.wbrsa)  # just return the existing stats
  }
  
  roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "neg", "pos"))
  
  # fit model
  full.model <- lmer(zDifference ~ visualDets + eventDets +
                       visualDets*valenceCategory + eventDets*valenceCategory +
                       (1|subID), data = roiData)
  
  # extract stats
  stats <- data.frame(summary(full.model)$coefficients[2:nrow(summary(full.model)$coefficients),])
  stats <- mutate(stats, ROI=curROI)
  model.stats.wbrsa <- rbind(model.stats.wbrsa, stats)
  
  return(model.stats.wbrsa)
}


```


loop over all ROIs to run the model: 

```{r}

model.stats.wbrsa <- data.frame(
  term = character(),
  estimate = numeric(),
  std.error = numeric(),
  statistic = numeric(),
  p.value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

rois <- levels(alldata$ROI)   # all ROIs in your dataset

for (r in rois) {
  model.stats.wbrsa <- detail_emo_neuref(r, model.stats.wbrsa)
}

# move the row names of model.stats into a proper column - causing errors if you don't
if (is.null(model.stats.wbrsa$term)) {
  model.stats.wbrsa <- model.stats.wbrsa %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "term")
}


```

```{r}
# Select all eventDets rows
event.model.wbrsa <- model.stats.wbrsa %>%
  filter(grepl("^eventDets[0-9]*$", term))   # ^ matches "eventDets", "eventDets1", ..., "eventDets41"

event.model.wbrsa$Pr.fdr <- p.adjust(p.values, method = "fdr")
event.model.wbrsa <- event.model.wbrsa %>%
```

make table 
```{r}
# Combine all post-FDR data frames with proper labels 
all_models <- bind_rows(
  event.model.wbrsa %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details"),
  visual.model.wbrsa %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details"),
  pos.model.wbrsa %>% mutate(model_name = "Positive valence"),
  neg.model.wbrsa %>% mutate(model_name = "Negative valence"),
  event.pos.model.wbrsa %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details × Positive valence"),
  event.neg.model.wbrsa %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details × Negative valence"),
  vis.pos.model.wbrsa %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details × Positive valence"),
  vis.neg.model.wbrsa %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details × Negative valence")
)

# Filter to only significant results
sig_results <- all_models %>%
  filter(sig == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(model_name, ROI)

# Display nicely
kbl(sig_results, digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "1200px", height = "800px")

# --- Clean and format for display ---
rsa_table_clean <- sig_results %>%
  select(model_name, ROI, Estimate, df, t.value, Pr.fdr) %>%
  
  # Round numeric columns
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3))) %>%
  
  # --- Split ROI into components ---
  separate(ROI, into = c("Hemisphere", "Network", "Region label"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  select(term = model_name, Network, `Region label`, Hemi = Hemisphere, Estimate, df, t.value, Pr.fdr) %>%
  
  # --- Sort and group for readability ---
  mutate(is_interaction = grepl("×", term)) %>%
  arrange(is_interaction, term, Network, `Region label`, Hemi) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(row_number() == 1, term, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # --- Format p-values ---
  mutate(
    Pr.fdr = case_when(
      Pr.fdr < 0.001 ~ "p < .001",
      Pr.fdr < 0.01  ~ "p < .01",
      Pr.fdr < 0.05  ~ "p < .05",
      TRUE           ~ as.character(signif(Pr.fdr, 3))
    )
  )

# --- Display in console (simple kable version) ---
kable(
  rsa_table_clean[, c("term_label", "Network", "Region label", "Hemi", "Estimate", "df", "t.value", "Pr.fdr")],
  col.names = c("Term", "Network", "Region label", "Hemi", "Estimate", "df", "t", "p (FDR)"),
  digits = 3,
  format = "simple"
)

# --- Export to Word (nice formatted table) ---
table_for_word <- rsa_table_clean %>%
  select(
    Term = term_label,
    Network,
    `Region label`,
    Hemi,
    Estimate,
    df,
    t = t.value,
    `p (FDR)` = Pr.fdr
  )

ft <- flextable(table_for_word) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  align(j = c("Estimate", "df", "t", "p (FDR)"), align = "center", part = "all")

doc <- read_docx() |> 
  body_add_par("RSA Results: Whole Brain", style = "heading 1") |> 
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = "RSA_results_table_encret.docx")

# --- Optional: restrict to DMN only ---
rsa_table_dmn <- rsa_table_clean %>%
  filter(Network %in% c("DefaultA", "DefaultB", "DefaultC")) %>%
  # Re-create term_label after filtering
  select(-term_label) %>%
  arrange(is_interaction, term, Network, `Region label`, Hemi) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(row_number() == 1, term, "")) %>%

ft_dmn <- flextable(rsa_table_dmn %>%

print(doc_dmn, target = "RSA_results_table_DMN_encret.docx")
```

### Extended Data Figure 4-1 (template-recall t-values)
setup t-value plotting 
```{r}
# Define network colors
network_colors <- c(
  "DMN A" = "slateblue1", 
  "DMN B" = "lightsteelblue3", 
  "DMN C" = "slateblue4"
)


# Purpose: Creates t-value scatter plot for DMN ROIs only
make_effect_plot_pub <- function(model_df, title = NULL) {
  
  # Relabel networks to match publication style
  plot_data <- model_df %>%
    mutate(
      network = case_when(
        grepl("DefaultA", ROI) ~ "Core midline",
        grepl("DefaultB", ROI) ~ "Dorsomedial",
        grepl("DefaultC", ROI) ~ "Medial temporal",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      ROI_clean = case_when(
        grepl("HIPP", ROI) ~ ROI,
        grepl("AMYG", ROI) ~ ROI,
        TRUE ~ ROI %>%
          gsub("^LH_|^RH_", "", .) %>%
          gsub("DefaultA_|DefaultB_|DefaultC_", "", .)
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(network != "Other")
  
  # Create plot with consistent formatting
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = network, y = t.value)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = network, fill = ifelse(sig, network, "white")),
      shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ROI_clean, color = network),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, nudge_x = 0.05, size = 2.5
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray", size = 0.5) + 
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("white" = "white", 
                 "Core midline" = "slateblue1", 
                 "Dorsomedial" = "lightsteelblue3", 
                 "Medial temporal" = "slateblue4")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Core midline" = "slateblue1", 
                 "Dorsomedial" = "lightsteelblue3", 
                 "Medial temporal" = "slateblue4")
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Template-recall similarity (t-value)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5), 
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5), 
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")
    )
  
  # Add title only if provided
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    p <- p + labs(title = title) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))
  }
  
  return(p)
}

```

## Figure 4b: whole-brain template-recall

```{r}
# create plot without a legend 
create_left_brain_no_legend <- function(model_data) {
  
  # Prepare brain data
  atlas <- as_tibble(schaefer17_200)
  
  plotvals <- model_data %>%
    filter(!ROI %in% c("LH_HIPP", "RH_HIPP", "LH_AMYG", "RH_AMYG")) %>%
    select(ROI, t_value = t.value, sig) %>%
    mutate(region = paste0('17Networks_', ROI)) %>%
    select(region, t_value, sig) %>%
    distinct(region, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  atlas_data <- left_join(atlas, plotvals, by = "region")
  
  # Get min/max for symmetric scale
  minval <- min(atlas_data$t_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  maxval <- max(atlas_data$t_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (abs(minval) > abs(maxval) & minval < 0 & maxval > 0) {
    maxval <- -1 * minval
  }
  if (abs(maxval) > abs(minval) & minval < 0 & maxval > 0) {
    minval <- -1 * maxval
  }
  
  # Set NA sig to FALSE
  atlas_data$sig[is.na(atlas_data$sig)] <- FALSE
  
  # Create left brain plot WITHOUT LEGEND
  brain_plot <- ggplot() + 
    geom_brain(
      atlas = atlas_data,
      mapping = aes(fill = t_value, color = sig),
      position = position_brain(position = 'horizontal'),
      hemi = "left",
      size = 0.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      limits = c(minval, maxval),
      na.value = "grey80",
      low = "#2166ac",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#b2182b",
      midpoint = 0
    ) + 
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = NA), 
      guide = "none"
    )
  
  return(brain_plot)
  
}
```

```{r}
# Load the Schaefer atlas
atlas <- as_tibble(schaefer17_200)

# Get all unique ROIs
rois <- unique(roi.rsa.data$ROI)

# Initialize results dataframe
ttest.results <- data.frame(
  ROI = character(),
  t.value = numeric(),
  df = numeric(),
  p.value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop through each ROI and run t-test
for (r in 1:length(rois)) {
  
  thisROI <- as.character(rois[r])
  
  # Calculate mean zDifference per subject for this ROI
  roiData <- roi.rsa.data %>%
    filter(ROI == thisROI) %>%
    group_by(subID) %>%
    summarize(meanZDiff = mean(zDifference, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Run t-test against zero
  t.results <- t.test(roiData$meanZDiff, mu = 0)
  
  # Store results
  ttest.results <- rbind(
    ttest.results, 
    data.frame(
      ROI = thisROI,
      t.value = t.results$statistic,
      df = t.results$parameter,
      p.value = t.results$p.value
    )
  )
}

# FDR correction
ttest.results$Pr.fdr <- p.adjust(ttest.results$p.value, method = "fdr")
ttest.results <- ttest.results %>%
  mutate(sig = Pr.fdr < 0.05)

# Display results summary
cat("\nTemplate-Recall Reactivation: Number of significant ROIs:", sum(ttest.results$sig), "\n")
print(ttest.results %>% filter(sig == TRUE))

# Save results CSV
write.csv(
  ttest.results, 
  file = file.path(output_dir, 'ttest_reactivation_template_recall_vs_zero.csv'),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Create LEFT BRAIN ONLY plot (no legend)
cat("Creating left brain plot for template-recall reactivation...\n")
reactivation_left_brain <- create_left_brain_no_legend(ttest.results)
```

# Analysis: recall stability RSA 



```{r}
detail_emo_neuref <- function(curROI, model.stats.wbrsa.stab) {

  # subset data for this ROI
  roiData <- roi.rsa.data %>% filter(as.character(ROI) == curROI)
  
  # skip if there’s no data
  if (nrow(roiData) == 0) {
    message("Skipping ROI: ", curROI, " (no data)")
    return(model.stats.wbrsa.stab)  # just return the existing stats
  }
  
  roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "neg", "pos"))
  
  # fit model
  full.model <- lmer(zDifference.stab ~ visualDets + eventDets +
                       visualDets*valenceCategory + eventDets*valenceCategory +
                       (1|subID), data = roiData)
  
  # extract stats
  stats <- data.frame(summary(full.model)$coefficients[2:nrow(summary(full.model)$coefficients),])
  stats <- mutate(stats, ROI=curROI)
  model.stats.wbrsa.stab <- rbind(model.stats.wbrsa.stab, stats)
  
  return(model.stats.wbrsa.stab)
}
```

```{r}
# Combine all post-FDR data frames WITH PROPER LABELS
all_models <- bind_rows(
  event.model.wbrsa.stab %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details"),
  visual.model.wbrsa.stab %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details"),

  event.pos.model.wbrsa.stab %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details × Positive valence"),
  event.neg.model.wbrsa.stab %>% mutate(model_name = "Narrative details × Negative valence"),
  vis.pos.model.wbrsa.stab %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details × Positive valence"),
  vis.neg.model.wbrsa.stab %>% mutate(model_name = "Perceptual details × Negative valence")

# Filter to only significant results
sig_results <- all_models %>%
  filter(sig == TRUE) %>%
  arrange(model_name, ROI)

# Display nicely
kbl(sig_results, digits = 3) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover")) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "1200px", height = "800px")

# --- Clean and format for display ---
rsa_table_clean <- sig_results %>%
  select(model_name, ROI, Estimate, df, t.value, Pr.fdr) %>%
  
  # Round numeric columns
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(., 3))) %>%
  
  # --- Split ROI into components ---
  separate(ROI, into = c("Hemisphere", "Network", "Region label"), sep = "_", extra = "merge") %>%
  select(term = model_name, Network, `Region label`, Hemi = Hemisphere, Estimate, df, t.value, Pr.fdr) %>%
  
  # --- Sort and group for readability ---
  mutate(is_interaction = grepl("×", term)) %>%
  arrange(is_interaction, term, Network, `Region label`, Hemi) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(row_number() == 1, term, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # --- Format p-values ---
  mutate(
    Pr.fdr = case_when(
      Pr.fdr < 0.001 ~ "p < .001",
      Pr.fdr < 0.01  ~ "p < .01",
      Pr.fdr < 0.05  ~ "p < .05",
      TRUE           ~ as.character(signif(Pr.fdr, 3))
    )
  )

# --- Display in console (simple kable version) ---
kable(
  rsa_table_clean[, c("term_label", "Network", "Region label", "Hemi", "Estimate", "df", "t.value", "Pr.fdr")],
  col.names = c("Term", "Network", "Region label", "Hemi", "Estimate", "df", "t", "p (FDR)"),
  digits = 3,
  format = "simple"
)

# --- Export to Word (nice formatted table) ---
table_for_word <- rsa_table_clean %>%
  select(
    Term = term_label,
    Network,
    `Region label`,
    Hemi,
    Estimate,
    df,
    t = t.value,
    `p (FDR)` = Pr.fdr
  )

ft <- flextable(table_for_word) %>%
  autofit() %>%
  theme_vanilla() %>%
  align(j = c("Estimate", "df", "t", "p (FDR)"), align = "center", part = "all")

doc <- read_docx() |> 
  body_add_par("RSA Results: Significant Effects", style = "heading 1") |> 
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = "RSA_results_table_stab.docx")

# --- Optional: restrict to DMN only ---
rsa_table_dmn <- rsa_table_clean %>%
  filter(Network %in% c("DefaultA", "DefaultB", "DefaultC")) %>%
  # Re-create term_label after filtering
  select(-term_label) %>%
  arrange(is_interaction, term, Network, `Region label`, Hemi) %>%
  group_by(term) %>%
  mutate(term_label = ifelse(row_number() == 1, term, "")) %>%

ft_dmn <- flextable(rsa_table_dmn %>%
```

## Extended Data Figure 5-1 (recall stability t-values)


setup 
```{r}
# Purpose: Creates t-value scatter plot for DMN ROIs only
make_effect_plot_pub.stab <- function(model_df, title = NULL) {
  
  # Relabel networks to match publication style
  plot_data <- model_df %>%
    mutate(
      network = case_when(
        grepl("DefaultA", ROI) ~ "Core midline",
        grepl("DefaultB", ROI) ~ "Dorsomedial",
        grepl("DefaultC", ROI) ~ "Medial temporal",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      ROI_clean = case_when(
        grepl("HIPP", ROI) ~ ROI,
        grepl("AMYG", ROI) ~ ROI,
        TRUE ~ ROI %>%
          gsub("^LH_|^RH_", "", .) %>%
          gsub("DefaultA_|DefaultB_|DefaultC_", "", .)
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(network != "Other")
  
  # Create plot with consistent formatting
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = network, y = t.value)) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = network, fill = ifelse(sig, network, "white")),
      shape = 21, size = 2, stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = ROI_clean, color = network),
      hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, nudge_x = 0.05, size = 2.5
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgray", size = 0.5) + 
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("white" = "white", 
                 "Core midline" = "slateblue1", 
                 "Dorsomedial" = "lightsteelblue3", 
                 "Medial temporal" = "slateblue4")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("Core midline" = "slateblue1", 
                 "Dorsomedial" = "lightsteelblue3", 
                 "Medial temporal" = "slateblue4")
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Recall stability (t-value)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5), 
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5), 
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")
    )
  
  # Add title only if provided
  if (!is.null(title)) {
    p <- p + labs(title = title) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

## Figure 5b: whole-brain recall stability + legend

```{r}
# Get all unique ROIs
rois <- unique(roi.rsa.data$ROI)

# Initialize results dataframe
ttest.results.stab <- data.frame(
  ROI = character(),
  t.value = numeric(),
  df = numeric(),
  p.value = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Loop through each ROI and run t-test
for (r in 1:length(rois)) {
  
  thisROI <- as.character(rois[r])
  
  # Calculate mean zDifference.stab per subject for this ROI
  roiData <- roi.rsa.data %>%
    filter(ROI == thisROI) %>%
    group_by(subID) %>%
    summarize(meanZDiff = mean(zDifference.stab, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  # Run t-test against zero
  t.results <- t.test(roiData$meanZDiff, mu = 0)
  
  # Store results
  ttest.results.stab <- rbind(
    ttest.results.stab, 
    data.frame(
      ROI = thisROI,
      t.value = t.results$statistic,
      df = t.results$parameter,
      p.value = t.results$p.value
    )
  )
}

# FDR correction
ttest.results.stab$Pr.fdr <- p.adjust(ttest.results.stab$p.value, method = "fdr")
ttest.results.stab <- ttest.results.stab %>%
  mutate(sig = Pr.fdr < 0.05)

# Display results summary
cat("\nRecall-Recall Stability: Number of significant ROIs:", sum(ttest.results.stab$sig), "\n")
print(ttest.results.stab %>% filter(sig == TRUE))

# Save results CSV
write.csv(
  ttest.results.stab, 
  file = file.path(output_dir, 'ttest_reactivation_recall_stability_vs_zero.csv'),
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Create LEFT BRAIN ONLY plot (no legend)

reactivation_left_brain <- create_left_brain_no_legend_stab(ttest.results.stab)

create_standalone_legend_small <- function(minval = -4, maxval = 4) {
  
  # Create a dummy dataset for the legend to add the correct min and max colors 
  legend_data <- data.frame(
    x = 1,
    y = seq(minval, maxval, length.out = 100)
  )
  
  legend_plot <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = y)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166ac",
      mid = "white",
      high = "#b2182b",
      midpoint = 0,
      name = "t-value",
      limits = c(minval, maxval),
      breaks = c(minval, 0, maxval),  # Explicitly set breaks at min, 0, max
      labels = c(as.character(minval), "0", as.character(maxval))
    ) +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +  # Smaller base size
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"),  # Slightly taller for readability
      legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      title = "t-value",
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0.5,
      barheight = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      barwidth = unit(0.25, "cm")
    ))
  
  return(legend_plot)
}

# Create and save the better small legend
```

```{r}
rsadata %>%

    zDifference = mean(zDifference, na.rm = TRUE),
    zDifference.stab = mean(zDifference.stab, na.rm = TRUE),
    regSuccess = first(as.numeric(regSuccess)),
```

## run both models 
```{r}
checkingrsa1 <- data.frame()
include_networks = c("DefaultA","DefaultB","DefaultC")

# define function
success_valence_rsa <- function(curROI,model.stats) {
  
  # RECALL
  roiData <- network.data.reviewer %>% filter(network %in% curROI)
  roiData$valenceCategory <- factor(roiData$valenceCategory, levels=c("neu", "neg", "pos"))
  full.model <- lmer(zDifference.stab ~ regSuccess*valenceCategory + (1|subID), data = roiData)
 
  
    stats <- data.frame(summary(full.model)$coefficients[2:nrow(summary(full.model)$coefficients),])
  stats <- mutate(stats,ROI=curROI)
  model.stats <- rbind(model.stats,stats)
  
  return(model.stats)
}

checkingrsa1 = success_valence_rsa("DefaultA", checkingrsa1)
checkingrsa1 = success_valence_rsa("DefaultB", checkingrsa1)
checkingrsa1 = success_valence_rsa("DefaultC", checkingrsa1)

```

```{r}
  scroll_box(width="400",height="200px")
```

## Extended Figure 1-1c (success and recall stability)

```{r}

# make sure valence order is consistent
network.data.reviewer$valenceCategory <- factor(network.data.reviewer$valenceCategory,
                                               levels = c("neu", "neg", "pos"))
# define function to run model + extract predictions for one network
get_preds <- function(cur_net) {
  dat <- network.data.reviewer %>% filter(network == cur_net)
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  mod <- lmer(zDifference.stab ~ regSuccess * valenceCategory + (1|subID), data = dat)
  preds <- ggpredict(mod, terms = c("regSuccess [all]", "valenceCategory"), type = "fixed")
  preds$network <- cur_net
  return(preds)
}
# run for all three subnetworks
include_networks <- c("DefaultA", "DefaultB", "DefaultC")
pred_activity_all <- map_dfr(include_networks, get_preds)
# relabel for pretty facets
pred_activity_all$network <- recode(pred_activity_all$network,
                                    "DefaultA" = "Core midline",
                                    "DefaultB" = "Dorsomedial",
                                    "DefaultC" = "Medial temporal")
# plot combined predictions
activity_plot <- ggplot(pred_activity_all, 
                        aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~ network, nrow = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("neu" = "#1f78b4",
                                "neg" = "#e3401a",
                                "pos" = "#33a02c"),
                     labels = c("Neutral", "Negative", "Positive"),
                     name = "Valence") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("neu" = "#1f78b4",
                               "neg" = "#e3401a",
                               "pos" = "#33a02c"),
                    labels = c("Neutral", "Negative", "Positive"),
                    name = "Valence") +
  labs(x = "Subjective success rating (mean centered)",
       y = "Recall stability")+
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", size = .5), 
    axis.line.y = element_line(color = "black", size = .5), 
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10), 
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", size = .5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")
  )
activity_plot
```

## create accurate legneds for brain plots

### create accurate legend
```{r}
# Replicates the limits logic in create_left_brain_no_legend(_stab) exactly
get_brain_limits <- function(model_data) {
  vals <- model_data %>%
    filter(!ROI %in% c("LH_HIPP", "RH_HIPP", "LH_AMYG", "RH_AMYG")) %>%
    pull(t.value)

  minval <- min(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  maxval <- max(vals, na.rm = TRUE)

  # same symmetrizing rules as the brain function
  if (abs(minval) > abs(maxval) & minval < 0 & maxval > 0) maxval <- -1 * minval
  if (abs(maxval) > abs(minval) & minval < 0 & maxval > 0) minval <- -1 * maxval

  c(minval, maxval)
}

create_matched_legend <- function(model_data, title = expression(italic(t)*"-value")) {

  lims <- get_brain_limits(model_data)
  cat("Legend limits (match brain plot):", round(lims, 3), "\n")

  # only label 0 if it's inside the range
  brks <- if (lims[1] < 0 & lims[2] > 0) c(lims[1], 0, lims[2]) else lims
  labs <- sprintf("%.2f", brks)
  labs[brks == 0] <- "0"

  legend_data <- data.frame(x = 1, y = seq(lims[1], lims[2], length.out = 100))

  p <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = y)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = lims,
      breaks = brks,
      labels = labs,
      name = title
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
      title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5,
      barheight = unit(1.2, "cm"), barwidth = unit(0.25, "cm")
    )) +
    theme_void(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 6)
    )

  # keep only the colorbar (drops the dummy gradient panel)
  cowplot::ggdraw(cowplot::get_legend(p)) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
}
```

```{r}
legend_plot <- create_matched_legend(ttest.results.stab)

#   plot = legend_plot,

#   width = 0.5, height = 1, units = "in", bg = "white"
# )
print(legend_plot)
```
